requirements.acceptance_criterion: Every existing agent has responsibility, knowledge, prompt/context/tool/output contracts, prior quality, failure patterns, resource needs and model suitability traced to source.
Freeze cases, expected results and scoring before corrections; preserve failing outputs and distinguish software, replay and actual inference.
Reproduce and correct technical contradictions at actual entry points without altering execution/ownership/budget gates; focused checks pass.
Evaluate each callable model role on identical frozen inputs, retaining all raw answers, timeouts and raw-policy distinctions.

Inventory existing and relevant tools with purpose, official docs, version, license, OS, formats, dependencies, resources, limitations, security and independent installed/integrated/tested/operational states.
Agents receive bounded applicable official tool facts with version provenance and uncertainty; catalog presence cannot grant execution.
Frozen questions and recorded/synthetic outputs measure supported flags, evidence meaning and unavailable capability without target traffic.
Design an explicit review-only code-artifact contract with no shell/deployment, credential access or target-execution path.
Implement bounded structured Python/test/defensive artifacts with documentation, dependency policy and evidence references through existing ownership and accounting.
Validate frozen valid/invalid artifacts using deterministic checks, static lint, dependency checks and resource/input bounds; no candidate code executes in the API.
Independent human reviewer assesses generated code quality and reproducibility; fresh model code is separately measured.
Trace Proxy/history/Repeater/Target/site map/Decoder/Comparer/session/transport/import by actual APIs and edition, with implemented/tested/unsupported distinctions.
Synthetic imports verify ownership, authentication, framing, integrity, redaction, errors and recovery; correct reproduced defects without enabling requests.
Record installed Burp version and demonstrate compatible extension behavior with synthetic evidence, or retain exact missing runtime prerequisite.

Cover authentication, authorization, sessions, input validation, crypto, access-control design, API/network/business logic and architecture with source-grounded expected answers and explicit independence limits.
Improve actual analysis code against frozen evidence, preserving facts/hypotheses/unknowns, false-positive controls, missing information, remediation and report provenance.
Frozen handoffs measure attribution, contradictions, unsupported/repeated claims, context relevance and detection of analytical errors; immutable ownership and review gates persist.
Compare actual specialist/peer outputs on identical recorded evidence with retained distinct contributions and error detection.
Diagnose historical Qwen/0.8B timeouts from retained timing/context/resources; freeze identical-input model rubric with latency/tokens/cost/failures and unavailable metrics.
Run admissible models on identical frozen inputs under existing budgets and report response-bound accuracy, structure, latency, tokens, cost and resources.

Every evaluated component exposes requirement, case, expected/actual, evidence, method, n, limitations and confidence; immutable expected answers, missing scores and development/evaluation separation are enforced.
Independent human assesses blinded frozen cases before senior equivalence can be claimed.
Generate requested HTML and JSON/CSV with all phase matrices, before/current, corrections, false positives, measured performance/cost and explicit missing capabilities.
Recompute source/evidence hashes and scoring from retained outputs; validate report/data consistency and rendered desktop/mobile report without fabricated results.
